messages:
alice_cust: Hey, noticed a sudden drop in reply quality starting ~08:12 UTC. We expect redwood-xxl-v2 but outputs are terse and lose context.

sarah_support: Sorry about that — can you share a request id or sample payload/response?

alice_cust: req_0a9f3d. We set region header to eu-west-1. Minimal repro below. Responses include a warning about fallback.

alice_cust: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-xxl-v2","input":"Summarize the following: ..."}'
```

alice_cust: Truncated response: `{ "model": "redwood-lite-v0", "output": "Short summary...", "warning": "served fallback variant" }`

alice_cust: We did not change our model selection — these outputs break product logic.

omar_infra: Paging infra. @sarah_support can you pull routing logs? Want to see if it rerouted to standby region.

deploy_bot: [auto-failover] 2026-03-16T08:11:59Z - primary eu-west-1 degraded, routing to standby eu-west-2, variant chosen: redwood-lite-v0 (compatibility fallback)

maria_prod: That looks like autoscaler+standby chose a lite variant. That should not override an explicit model pin unless allowed. Any policy changes?

sarah_support: Checking customer config: do you have allow_variant_fallback set to true for this API key? Fallbacks are gated by that flag.

alice_cust: We never set that flag. Using defaults. Our payload explicitly requested redwood-xxl-v2.

omar_infra: I pulled trace id trace-55b for req_0a9f3d. Primary health checks failed -> autoscaler triggered region failover. Failover routing profile for standby was "cost-priority" which permits serving lightweight variants when capacity constrained.

eng_oncall: Noted. We should never substitute variant when customer explicitly specifies model string. Opening hotfix to ensure model pinning prevents downgrade path.

maria_prod: Deploying a config patch to enforce model pin honor during routing resolution. Canarying now for 5 minutes then roll.

sarah_support: Short-term mitigation for you: set header `X-Disable-Variant-Fallback: 1` or set `allow_variant_fallback:false` in the control plane for your key. That will force failure instead of silent downgrade.

alice_cust: Appreciate that. Also saw a 401 on an internal probe around 08:10 — related?

omar_infra: The 401 was a transient auth retry when cross-region probes hit the standby control plane during the failover window. It increased probe latencies and contributed to the autoscaler's decision tree, but it didn’t directly cause the variant swap.

lee_billing: Note: calls served as redwood-lite-v0 were billed at lite rates automatically. If you want, we can review the window for credits given the degraded output.

alice_cust: Yes please — we'll need credits and a timeline + logs for compliance. Also want assurance pinned models won't be silently substituted again.

sarah_support: Understood. Action items we9ll deliver tonight: (1) full timeline + routing traces for req_0a9f3d, (2) logs showing policy resolution that picked cost-priority standby, (3) PR for hotfix to enforce explicit model pinning, (4) recommended control-plane setting and header for immediate protection.

maria_prod: Patch merged to canary. Monitoring. I'll write a brief postmortem and link the PR in #eng-runtime once validated.

alice_cust: We'll try the header workaround now and confirm. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

sarah_support: Thanks — keeping this thread open until we confirm repaired and we've shared artifacts. :thumbsup:
